items.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 17 at 3:35AM EDT until September 18 at 2:00AM EDT by NWS Tampa Bay Ruskin FL
items.description:
* WHAT...Northeast winds 20 to 25 knots with gusts up to 30
knots.

* WHERE...Portions of Gulf of America.

* WHEN...Until 2 AM EDT Friday.

* IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
items.instruction:
Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller
vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.
